meta.name: Epic Gardening TV
meta.description:
Epic Gardening TV exists to help you grow, no matter what you grow. Through inspiration and education, we make gardening easy, whether you're experienced or brand new.

Shows: The Beet: A Podcast for Plant Lovers, Jujubes, Coffee Grounds, and Bean Bonanzas, The Beet, Jacques in the Garden, Happy Harvests & Mint Management
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
